title: Manage your first GitHub project in OWI

steps.title: Welcome to your AI company
steps.body: You remain the owner. OWI helps turn one goal into reviewable tasks, proposes qualified workers, and keeps every important decision visible. The tour explains the workflow; it never spends money or runs a model for you.

steps.title: Choose a GitHub project
steps.body: The Manager reads an on-demand GitHub snapshot without cloning or scanning source code. Choose a server-discovered repository, then refresh its issues, pull requests, and failed Actions. If GitHub is not configured, this room shows the exact setup needed and does not invent projects.

steps.title: Promote work deliberately
steps.body: GitHub items stay read-only until you explicitly import one. Import creates an unassigned local draft with source provenance; it never staffs a model, spends money, runs code, or writes back to GitHub. Private-source tasks keep a confidential privacy floor.

steps.title: Shape small, checkable tasks
steps.body: Review every draft before spending. Add, edit, or remove tasks, keep different kinds of work separate, and write acceptance checks that make the returned result easy to judge.

steps.title: Compare the proposed staff
steps.body: Staffing evaluates capability, tools, privacy, quality evidence, and price for each task. Inspect the selected worker, qualified alternatives, exclusions, runner readiness, and accepted-result cost forecast before execution.

steps.title: Run only the saved assignment
steps.body: The Run control uses the exact staffed worker and server-owned brief. When it finishes, inspect the real output and checks. Accept it, send it back, retry the same assignment, or restaff using new evidence.

steps.title: Manage with evidence
steps.body: Results keeps outcomes beside the exact worker and task. Forecasts remain forecasts; actual spend, savings, CO₂, and water stay unknown until receipts or measured evidence exist. You can restart this tour whenever you need it.
